Modular process skids & skid-mounted plants

Timely execution, minimum site work. We design, fabricate and assemble complete process units in our own works, so your plant arrives ready to connect.

Discuss your skid project Request brochure by email

What is a modular process skid?

A process skid is a self-contained system built into a steel frame, or module, for easy transport and installation. One skid can hold a single process step or, combined with others, an entire plant.

Because skids are built in a factory rather than on site, fabrication quality is higher, and the work is safer and easier to control. On site, the skids are placed, connected and commissioned. This means less site labour, less disruption and a shorter project schedule.

Fermentation to distillation: complete plants on skids

What we build on skids

  • Fermentation and distillation units for ethanol and neutral alcohol
  • Brewhouse and cellar systems for breweries
  • Solvent recovery and stripper units
  • Agitated thin-film dryers (ATFD) and evaporation modules
  • CO₂ recovery and purification units
  • Mixing, dosing and CIP skids
  • Water treatment and condensate polishing units

What each skid includes

  • Structural steel frame and platforms
  • Process equipment: columns, vessels, exchangers and tanks
  • Piping, valves and fittings
  • Instrumentation and control elements
  • Electrical cabling and junction boxes
  • Insulation

Advantages of skid-mounted plants

Shorter project schedule

Skids are built in our works while your site civil work proceeds in parallel.

Higher fabrication quality

Welding, piping and inspection are done under controlled factory conditions.

Lower site cost

Less site labour, erection time and hook-up work.

Improved site safety

Most work at height and hot work happens in our works, not at your site.

Designed for your space

Each skid is laid out in 3D to fit your available area, with access for operation and maintenance.

Suited to remote locations

A strong option where skilled site labour is limited.

Relocatable

Skids can be moved or expanded as your needs change.

Single-point responsibility

One supplier for process design, equipment, piping, electrical and instrumentation.

How we build your skid

  1. Process designSized for your capacity, feedstock and site conditions.
  2. 3D modellingLayout, piping and access designed together, so connections are simple plug-and-play into your plant.
  3. FabricationIn our 2,500 TPA works near Pune, using SS 304/316, carbon steel and special alloys.
  4. Shop assembly and trialsSkids are assembled and checked in our works before dispatch.
  5. InspectionA project-specific quality plan, NDT by ASNT-certified inspectors, and third-party inspection by TÜV, Lloyd's Register, BV, SGS or DNV on request.
  6. DispatchOur works is 2 km from ICD Talegaon, with road links to JNPT port for export worldwide.
  7. Site supportErection supervision, commissioning and after-sales service.

Codes and standards

Equipment on our skids is designed and built to the codes your project requires. MEGA is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 by TÜV NORD.

ASME Sec VIII Div 1PEDTEMAAPI 650DINAD MerkblätterIS 2825IBR

Frequently asked questions

Can a complete plant be supplied on skids?

Yes. Fermentation, distillation, evaporation and utility sections can each be built as skids and connected on site.

How are skids shipped?

Skids are sized for road and sea transport and shipped from our works through JNPT port.

Can skids connect to my existing control system?

Yes. Instruments on the skid can be wired to your existing PLC or DCS, or we can supply the automation.

Which industries use your skids?

Distillery and ethanol, brewery, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and oil and gas.

Planning a skid-mounted plant?

Send us your process requirement and site details. Our engineers will propose the best modular layout.

CO₂ recovery plants

Turn fermentation CO₂ into a saleable product.

Request a proposal Request brochure by email

From waste gas to revenue

Every distillery and brewery releases large volumes of CO₂ during fermentation. Usually it is vented to the atmosphere.

A MEGA CO₂ recovery plant captures this gas, purifies it and liquefies it into food-grade CO₂ for beverages, food processing and industry. You either sell it or use it in your own plant, reduce your emissions, and stop buying CO₂ from outside suppliers.

  • Additional revenue from a by-product
  • Self-sufficiency in CO₂ for carbonation and process use
  • Lower greenhouse gas emissions from your site
  • Low operating cost, thanks to an energy-efficient design

CO₂ sources: distillery and fuel ethanol fermentation, brewery fermentation. Add any other sources you supply

How it works

  1. Foam separationFoam is removed from the raw fermentation gas.
  2. Gas holdingThe gas is collected in a gas balloon to balance flow.
  3. Gas washingWater-soluble impurities are removed in the gas washer.
  4. CompressionThe clean gas is compressed.
  5. Purification and deodorisingKMnO₄ scrubbing and activated carbon remove odours and trace impurities.
  6. DryingA dehydrator removes moisture.
  7. LiquefactionAn ammonia refrigeration system liquefies the CO₂ and purges non-condensable gases such as oxygen and nitrogen.
  8. Stripping and storageA stripper gives final purification, and liquid CO₂ is transferred to storage tanks, then to tankers or cylinders.

Frequently asked questions

Can a CO₂ plant be added to an existing distillery or brewery?

Yes. The plant connects to your existing fermenters, and we size it to your fermentation CO₂ output.

What grade of CO₂ does the plant produce?

Food-grade CO₂, suitable for beverage carbonation and food applications. Add the purity figure once confirmed

How much CO₂ can be recovered?

This depends on your fermentation capacity and feedstock. Send us your production data and we will calculate the recoverable CO₂ for your plant.

Is the plant automatic?

Yes. It runs fully automatically under PLC control with SCADA monitoring and data logging.

Recover your CO₂. Recover value.

Tell us your fermentation capacity, and our engineers will estimate the CO₂ you can recover.
